conflict_examples.condition: GW == Wahapedia and BSData/New Recruit differ
conflict_examples.action: Prefer GW rule fact; flag probable structured implementation/runtime bug.
Create SOURCE_CONFLICT and verify against applicable current official source.

conflict_examples.condition: BSData source != New Recruit runtime projection
conflict_examples.action: Create RUNTIME_PROJECTION_DRIFT; do not rewrite normative rules.

unknowns: Exact New Recruit polling/synchronization interval from BSData was not documented in the checked material; do not invent a cadence.
